about.label: Nvidia
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units, systems on chips, and application programming interfaces for data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and mobile and automotive applications.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje grafické procesory a čipy pro umělou inteligenci – dnes jejich největší dodavatel na světě.

about.label: Apple Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Cupertino, California, in Silicon Valley, and known for consumer electronics, software and online services.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí iPhony, Macy, iPady a další elektroniku a prodává k nim software a služby.

about.label: Microsoft
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington. The company became influential in the rise of personal computers through software like Windows and has since expanded into areas such as Internet services, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, video gaming, and more.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí Windows a Office a provozuje cloud Azure.

about.label: Amazon
about.summary: American multinational conglomerate engaged in e-commerce, retail, cloud computing, online advertising, digital streaming, entertainment, and artificial intelligence.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, největší internetový obchod na světě a největší poskytovatel cloudových služeb (AWS).

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, mateřská společnost Googlu a YouTube, která vydělává hlavně na reklamě a cloudu.

about.label: Micron Technology
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company that manufactures computer memory and computer data storage products, including dynamic random-access memory, flash memory, High Bandwidth Memory, and solid-state drives.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce paměťových čipů (DRAM, flash) a SSD disků.

about.label: JPMorgan Chase
about.summary: American multinational banking institution headquartered in New York City and incorporated in Delaware.
about.summary_cs: Největší americká banka, se sídlem v New Yorku.

about.label: ExxonMobil
about.summary: American multinational oil and gas corporation headquartered in Spring, Texas, a suburb of Houston. It is vertically integrated across the entire oil and gas industry, as well as within its chemicals division, which produces plastic, synthetic rubber, and other chemical products.
about.summary_cs: Americká ropná firma, největší v USA, která těží ropu a plyn, rafinuje paliva a vyrábí chemikálie.

about.label: Caterpillar Inc.
about.summary: American manufacturer of construction, mining, and other engineering equipment.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce stavebních a těžebních strojů, motorů a turbín.

about.label: Broadcom
about.summary: American multinational designer, developer, manufacturer, and global supplier of a wide range of semiconductor and infrastructure software products.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce a dodavatel široké škály polovodičů a infrastrukturního softwaru.

about.label: Johnson & Johnson
about.summary: American multinational pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical technologies corporation headquartered in New Brunswick, New Jersey.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí léky a zdravotnické prostředky.

about.label: Meta Platforms
about.summary: American multinational technology company and is one of the Big Tech companies. Meta owns and operates several prominent social media platforms and communication services, including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která provozuje Facebook, Instagram a WhatsApp a vydělává hlavně na reklamě.

about.label: Visa Inc.
about.summary: American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in San Francisco, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje platební síť Visa, největší na světě.

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, mateřská společnost Googlu a YouTube, která vydělává hlavně na reklamě a cloudu.

about.label: Applied Materials
about.summary: American corporation that supplies equipment, services and software for the manufacture of semiconductor chips for electronics, flat panel displays for computers, smartphones, televisions, and solar products.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává zařízení, služby a software pro výrobu čipů, displejů a solárních panelů.

about.label: Cisco
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate corporation that develops, manufactures, and sells hardware, software, telecommunications equipment and other high-technology services and products focused on networking, cybersecurity and AI. Cisco specializes in specific tech markets, such as the Internet of things, domain security, videoconferencing, and ener
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí síťová zařízení, například routery a switche, a software pro sítě a bezpečnost.

about.label: Intel
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It designs, manufactures, and sells computer components such as central processing units and related products for business and consumer markets.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce procesorů pro počítače a servery, který vyrábí čipy i na zakázku.

about.label: RTX
about.summary: American multinational aerospace and defense conglomerate headquartered in Arlington, Virginia. RTX manufactures aircraft engines, avionics, aerostructures, cybersecurity solutions, guided missiles, air defense systems, satellites, and drones.
about.summary_cs: Americká obranná a letecká firma, která vyrábí letecké motory Pratt & Whitney, avioniku a rakety Raytheon.

about.label: Chevron Corporation
about.summary: American multinational energy corporation predominantly specializing in oil and gas.
about.summary_cs: Americká ropná firma, jedna z největších na světě, která těží ropu a plyn a rafinuje paliva.

about.label: Pfizer
about.summary: American multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology corporation headquartered at The Spiral in Manhattan, New York City. Pfizer develops and produces medication and vaccines for immunology, oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, and neurology.
about.summary_cs: Americká farmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky a vakcíny.

about.label: Procter & Gamble
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce drogerie a hygienických potřeb se značkami jako Pampers, Gillette, Ariel a Head & Shoulders.

about.label: Tesla
about.summary: American multinational automotive and clean energy company. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, it designs, manufactures, and sells battery electric vehicles, stationary battery energy storage devices from home to grid-scale, solar panels and solar shingles, and related products and services.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce elektromobilů, bateriových úložišť a solárních systémů.

about.label: NextEra Energy
about.summary: American energy company that is the world's largest electric utility holding company by market capitalization, with a valuation of over $187 billion as of July 2026.
about.summary_cs: Americká energetická firma, největší výrobce elektřiny z větru a slunce na světě a vlastník floridského dodavatele elektřiny.

about.label: Northrop Grumman Corporation
about.summary: American aerospace and defense company that designs and manufactures systems for aeronautics, defense, missions, and space.
about.summary_cs: Americká obranná firma, která vyrábí letadla, rakety, satelity a kosmické systémy.

about.label: Deere & Company
about.summary: American corporation that manufactures agricultural machinery, heavy equipment, forestry machinery, diesel engines, drivetrains used in heavy equipment and lawn care equipment.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce zemědělských, stavebních a lesnických strojů pod značkou John Deere.

about.label: Bank of America
about.summary: American multinational bank and financial services holding company headquartered at the Bank of America Corporate Center in Charlotte, North Carolina, with investment banking and auxiliary headquarters in Manhattan.
about.summary_cs: Americká banka se sídlem v Charlotte, druhá největší v USA.

about.label: Lockheed Martin
about.summary: American defense and aerospace manufacturer.
about.summary_cs: Americká obranná a letecká firma, největší zbrojař na světě, výrobce stíhaček F-35.

about.label: Eli Lilly and Company
about.summary: American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, with offices in 18 countries. Its products are sold in approximately 125 countries.
about.summary_cs: Americká farmaceutická firma, která vyrábí léky na cukrovku a obezitu (Mounjaro, Zepbound), rakovinu a další onemocnění.

about.label: Palantir Technologies
about.summary: American publicly traded company that develops data integration and analytics software.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, která dodává platformy pro analýzu dat a umělou inteligenci vládám, armádám i firmám.

about.label: Lam Research
about.summary: American supplier of wafer-fabrication equipment and related services to the semiconductor industry.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí zařízení pro výrobu čipů, hlavně pro leptání a nanášení vrstev.

about.label: Berkshire Hathaway
about.summary: American multinational conglomerate holding company headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. Originally a textile manufacturer, the company transitioned into a conglomerate starting in 1965 under the management of chairman and CEO Warren Buffett and vice chairman Charlie Munger.
about.summary_cs: Americký konglomerát Warrena Buffetta, který vlastní pojišťovny, železnici, energetiku a desítky dalších firem a velké podíly v akciích.

about.label: The Home Depot
about.summary: American multinational home improvement retail corporation which sells tools, construction products, appliances, and services including fuel and transportation rentals.
about.summary_cs: Americký řetězec obchodů pro kutily a stavebniny, největší na světě.

about.label: Goldman Sachs
about.summary: American multinational investment bank and financial services company.
industry: financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
industry_cs: finanční služby, kromě pojišťovnictví a penzijního financování
about.summary_cs: Americká investiční banka a správce aktiv.

about.label: Palo Alto Networks
about.summary: American multinational cybersecurity company with headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The core product is a platform that includes advanced firewalls and cloud-based offerings that extend those firewalls to cover other aspects of security.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která vyrábí firewally a cloudovou ochranu sítí.

about.label: 3M
about.summary: American multinational conglomerate operating in the fields of industry, worker safety, and consumer goods.
about.summary_cs: Americký konglomerát, který vyrábí tisíce produktů pro průmysl, ochranu zdraví při práci i domácnosti – od lepicích pásek a Post-it lístků po respirátory.

about.label: Adobe
about.summary: American multinational computer software company based in San Jose, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, autor Photoshopu, Acrobatu a dalších nástrojů pro tvorbu a úpravu obsahu.

about.label: Salesforce
about.summary: American enterprise software company headquartered in San Francisco, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, největší dodavatel cloudového softwaru pro řízení vztahů se zákazníky (CRM).

about.label: Morgan Stanley
about.summary: American multinational investment bank and financial services company.
about.summary_cs: Americká investiční banka a správce majetku.

about.label: Qualcomm
about.summary: American multinational technology corporation headquartered in San Diego, California. The company develops and designs technologies for global communications and computing, including next-generation mobile networks, smart devices, and semiconductors — such as mobile processors and artificial intelligence chips.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje čipy pro mobily a bezdrátovou komunikaci a licencuje své patenty.

about.label: Check Point
about.summary: Israeli cybersecurity company. With operations in over 60 countries, the company protects over 100,000 organizations globally through its software services.
about.summary_cs: Izraelská firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, jejíž software chrání přes 100 000 organizací po celém světě.

about.label: UnitedHealth Group
about.summary: American multinational company based in Eden Prairie, Minnesota, specializing in health insurance and health care services.
about.summary_cs: Americká zdravotnická firma, největší zdravotní pojišťovna v USA, která provozuje i lékařskou péči.

about.label: The Coca-Cola Company
about.summary: American multinational corporation founded in January 1892, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It manufactures, sells and markets soft drinks including Coca-Cola, other non-alcoholic beverage concentrates and syrups, and alcoholic beverages.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce nápojů, mimo jiné Coca-Coly, Sprite a Fanty.

about.label: Citigroup
about.summary: American multinational investment bank and financial services company based in New York City.
industry_cs: finanční služby, kromě pojišťovnictví a penzijního financování
about.summary_cs: Americká banka se sídlem v New Yorku, která působí ve více než 150 zemích.

about.label: CME Group
about.summary: CME Group Inc., headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, operates exchanges and provides clearing services for trading in financial derivatives such as futures contracts, options, and swaps. The company operates the Globex Trading System, an electronic trading platform that allows customers in approximately 150 countries to trade futures and options contracts.
about.summary_cs: Americký provozovatel burz, na kterých se obchodují futures, opce a swapy, a poskytovatel zúčtovacích služeb.

about.label: TJX Companies
about.summary: American multinational off-price department store corporation, headquartered in Framingham, Massachusetts.
about.summary_cs: Americký řetězec diskontních obchodů s oblečením a vybavením domácnosti, mimo jiné TJ Maxx a TK Maxx.
